_note: Level of Traffic Stress thresholds (Furth/Mekuria segment model). Edit here to retune without touching code. LTS 1 = comfortable for all ages/abilities; LTS 4 = only experienced cyclists.
_highway_note: Default speed (mph) and lane count when OSM maxspeed / lanes tag is absent. Source: DRCOG speed limits fill gaps for ~61% of roads lacking OSM maxspeed.
_lts1_note: Facility types that are LTS 1 regardless of speed/lanes.
_mixed_note: Mixed-traffic rules. Evaluated in order; first match wins.

mixed_traffic_rules.comment: speed >= 35 or lanes >= 4 on anything not already matched

_lane_note: Painted/buffered lane rules. buffered_lane is one LTS better than painted at the same speed/lanes.
_drop_note: Highway types to exclude from the network (not relevant for surface-quality or bike routing).
_bbox_note: Metro extract bounding box: west, south, east, north.
_osm_tags_note: Tags to keep on edges (everything else is stripped to reduce size).
